description: Inspect or change a conversation's queue of pending tasks (it only manages tasks already queued; enqueue with dsh_send(queue=true); **memory-only**, lost on restart). action=list lists them; remove cancels one and writes a cancelled sentinel; update rewrites the queued text; promote moves one to the front.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.

name: dsh_queue
title: Manage queue
